# Agora WUI

> Framework-agnostic React Teams UI for collaboration through an Agora Hub.

## Document index

- [README.md](README.md): overview and deployment boundary.
- [docs/getting-started.md](docs/getting-started.md): embedding and authentication.
- [docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md): ownership and transport.
- [docs/api.md](docs/api.md): public API.
- [docs/faq.md](docs/faq.md): common questions.
- [docs/troubleshooting.md](docs/troubleshooting.md): recovery guidance.

---

## README.md

Agora WUI is a framework-agnostic React Teams interface for Agora Hub. It is the web companion to `agora` and `agora-tui`. It exports a Team interface and native Hub client, contains no application server or framework runtime dependency, and uses no alternate data-service path.

Build with `npm install` followed by `npm run build`. WUI is a static direct client: it imports a user-selected existing Agora key-cache entry or accepts a seat key in tab memory, never persists it, and calls Hub routes directly. Browser WebSockets use Agora's documented `/ws?token=KEY` lane. Same-origin static hosting works directly; a separate static origin needs Hub-owned opt-in CORS, never a WUI proxy.

---

## docs/getting-started.md

Use Node.js 20 or later and an Agora Hub speaking `agora/0.4`. Import `HubClient` and `TeamPage` into a React host. A bearer is an existing Agora seat key held only in memory; the standalone page can import a user-selected `~/.agora/keys.json` entry. Cross-origin browser deployment needs explicit Hub CORS permission. AI integration is optional, host-owned, and read-only.

---

## docs/architecture.md

Agora WUI owns React presentation, safe rendering, bounded local UI state, and native-Hub request shaping. Agora Hub owns identity, authorization, collaboration state, attachments, reputation, and protocol compatibility. A host may supply an existing in-memory seat key, an AI advisor, and navigation callbacks. Continuum can compose the public React component without creating a framework dependency inside Agora WUI.

---

## docs/api.md

`TeamPage` accepts an optional `HubClient`, optional read-only `advisor`, and host navigation/focus callbacks. `HubClient` accepts `base_url` and an optional memory-only existing seat key; all REST calls add the Agora client header, and its WebSocket URL derives the Hub's native browser route. It exposes native Hub operations for identity, channels, messages, inbox, search, files, attachments, direct messages, reputation, and moderation. Root routes include `/whoami`, `/healthz`, `/channels`, `/inbox/ack`, and `/search`.

---

## docs/faq.md and docs/troubleshooting.md

Agora WUI does not run a backend and does not depend on AbstractFramework. Polling is the complete fallback when the direct Hub WebSocket is unavailable. Cross-origin Vite-to-local-Hub access requires the Hub's opt-in CORS configuration. Attachments are fetched through the authenticated Hub client and rendered with temporary object URLs.
